labels.label: ExecuteSQL   - Runs a SELECT query and outputs results as Avro FlowFiles
ExecuteSQLRecord - Same as ExecuteSQL but outputs using a configurable Record Writer (CSV, JSON, etc.)
QueryDatabaseTable - Incrementally fetches rows from a table — tracks the last value (e.g., max ID/date) to only get new/changed rows
QueryDatabaseTableRecord  - Same as above but with Record Writer support
GenerateTableFetch    - Generates SQL SELECT statements for parallel fetching — used with ExecuteSQL for large table pagination
PutSQL - Executes INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE using FlowFile attributes as parameters (${attr})
PutDatabaseRecord - Inserts/Updates/Deletes using Record Reader — reads structured data directly (CSV, JSON, Avro) and maps to DB columns
